entries.heading: EXTENSION OF PROHIBITION RELATING TO MISSILE DEFENSE INFORMATION AND SYSTEMS
ancestors: TITLE XVI—SPACE ACTIVITIES, STRATEGIC PROGRAMS, AND INTELLIGENCE MATTERS
entries.text:
SEC. 1642. EXTENSION OF PROHIBITION RELATING TO MISSILE DEFENSE 
                          INFORMATION AND SYSTEMS.

    Section 130h(e) of title 10, United States Code, is amended by 
striking ``January 1, 2021'' and inserting ``January 1, 2026''.
